name: Acknowledge + Retry Queue Messages
description: Acknowledge + Retry Queue Messages Acknowledge + Retry messages from a Queue POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/ack
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/ack
Acknowledge + Retry messages from a Queue
Required: queue_id (path); account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Delete Previewed Queue Messages
description: Delete Previewed Queue Messages Delete previewed messages from a Queue. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/preview/ack
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/preview/ack
Delete previewed messages from a Queue. Note that messages acknowledged this way aren't considered delivered, they are instantly deleted from this queue and do not affect metrics.
Required: queue_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/extend

context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}/messages/peek

name: Update Queue
description: Update Queue Updates a Queue. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/queues/{queue_id}
